def format_shipping_address(name, street, city, postcode):
    a = str(name).strip()
    b = str(street).strip()
    c = f"{str(city).strip()} {str(postcode).strip()}"
    return a + "\n" + b + "\n" + c
fix_rationale: Removed the stray print statement to avoid side effects and ensure only the formatted shipping address is returned as specified.
